label: ESTIMATE: literature sheet-flow values. Not calibrated for Barcelona.
source: USDA-SCS/NRCS (1986), Urban Hydrology for Small Watersheds, Technical Release 55 (TR-55), Table 3-1 'Roughness coefficients (Manning's n) for sheet flow', compiled from Engman (1986) J. Irrig. Drain. Eng. 112(1):39-53.
notes: Values apply to shallow sheet flow (< about 3 cm). Higher depths on streets tend toward open-channel values (Chow 1959, concrete/asphalt about 0.013-0.016).
Mapping land-cover classes to these surfaces is an ASSUMPTION pending G3 (SIOSE/CORINE).
